craft_notes: Sthāyin: Sanskrit return — the world's doubtlessness. Sanskrit-first: nijadṛḍha-prasiddhi-ghaṭite kept compound; loka asti niḥśaṅkaḥ kept world-is-doubtless. Rows: 1 ('stands doubtless' closes — niḥśaṅka end-weight), 5 (five-token monostich — the return-to-Sanskrit takes little room), 6 (register snap back). Close: 'stands doubtless.' Rejected: 'certainly' — killed: niḥśaṅka is without-doubt (armed absence of doubt); keeping Prakrit — killed: the text returns to Sanskrit for the assertion.

reads_against.argmap: What is asserted of the world? → The world's transaction, rooted in nija-ḍṛḍha-prasiddhi, stands niḥśaṅka — doubtless.
c1_essence: In the world's own-firm transaction stands doubtless.
reads_against.c1_rasa: adbhuta-śānta of authority established (wonder settling into doctrinal calm)
